kingAttackStudy.materialAndKingSafety: The queen continues checking on f6 without throwing away the material advantage. The short excerpt does not establish a forced mate.
kingAttackStudy.badPlan: Qxf8+ is a textbook example of a forcing capture that fails to ...Kxf8 because the king protects the rook.
kingAttackStudy.context: White owns c2 as a future counterpasser; the player must still avoid the immediate rook-supported ...Kxf8 recapture. A white bishop on c1 can influence the h6 diagonal later but cannot shield the poisoned f8 capture.
